scenarios.title: Happy path from planning to completed briefs
scenarios.objective: Prove the core product story: context -> planning -> generated tasks -> mission control -> representative task completion.
preconditions: RelayOps project exists in MARKETING domain.
All seven context files are available.
steps: Create a planning thread and reference the seven uploaded documents.
Advance from discovery to blueprint once the KPI target is explicit.
Advance from blueprint to task_mapping and use Generate Tasks from Chat.
Move task tsk_mkt_005 through TODO -> IN_PROGRESS -> IN_REVIEW -> DONE with all three briefs attached.
expectedOutcomes: Task generation happens only after task_mapping is reached.
The brief task ends in DONE with three concrete deliverable files.

scenarios.title: Missing launch brief blocks task-generation recommendation
scenarios.objective: Ensure incomplete business context does not advance the thread to task_mapping.
preconditions: launch_brief_audit_assistant.md is missing or not referenced
steps: Start planning with only the brand framework and interview notes.
Ask the planner for task generation prematurely.
expectedOutcomes: The planner explicitly asks for the launch brief.
The thread does not progress to task_mapping.
Generate Tasks from Chat is not yet appropriate.

scenarios.title: Reviewer rejects incomplete content brief package
scenarios.objective: Prove that a task may reach IN_REVIEW but still fail the scenario acceptance check.
steps: Move tsk_mkt_005 to IN_REVIEW with only one draft brief present.
expectedOutcomes: The reviewer rejects the task as incomplete.
The scenario feedback points out the missing two briefs and missing acceptance evidence.

scenarios.title: Blocked KPI tracker is restored and completed
scenarios.objective: Exercise the app's actual blocked-task recovery path.
preconditions: Task tsk_mkt_007 is BLOCKED because source systems are not yet confirmed.
steps: Confirm that HubSpot campaign attribution and the web analytics launch dashboard are the source systems.
Restore the task from BLOCKED to TODO.
Move the task through IN_PROGRESS -> IN_REVIEW -> DONE.
expectedOutcomes: The restore step uses BLOCKED -> TODO rather than a direct jump to DONE.
The KPI tracker spec is present before final approval.

scenarios.title: Planning-side mutation refines KPI task description
scenarios.objective: Exercise the planning mutation workflow after tasks already exist.
preconditions: Task generation has already created tsk_mkt_007.
steps: Ask the planner to tighten the KPI task without changing the title.
Approve the returned mutation for tsk_mkt_007.
expectedOutcomes: The mutation updates only the description field.
The mutation action is saved as approved.
The new description includes source systems and weekly cadence.
